_note: Sample career pathways, hand-written for ModuleMatch. Skill weights are illustrative judgements and the opportunities are generic examples, not live listings.

pathways.title: Aerospace and motorsport
pathways.description: Performance engineering for aircraft, engines and race cars: aerodynamics, propulsion, structures and vehicle dynamics, usually backed by simulation and testing.
sampleOpportunities: Formula Student or Racing Green design team
Summer placement in aerodynamics, powertrain or gas-turbine engineering
Graduate scheme at an aerospace or motorsport manufacturer

pathways.title: Energy transition
pathways.description: Low-carbon power, storage, nuclear and clean transport: analysing energy systems and making the engineering and economic case for decarbonisation.
sampleOpportunities: Internship with a renewable energy or grid-storage developer
Graduate scheme in nuclear new build or decommissioning
Battery or electric-powertrain test engineer placement

pathways.title: Robotics and automation
pathways.description: Robots, mechatronic products and automated systems: sensing, actuation, embedded software and control.
sampleOpportunities: Robotics society or RoboCup team
Summer placement in warehouse or manufacturing automation
Embedded systems engineer graduate role

pathways.title: Biomedical devices
pathways.description: Implants, prosthetics and medical devices: materials, mechanics and testing applied to the human body.
sampleOpportunities: Prosthetics or MedTech student project
Summer research placement in a biomechanics lab
Graduate role in medical-device design and regulatory testing

pathways.title: Software and data
pathways.description: Engineering software, data science and machine learning roles that value a mechanical engineer's modelling background.
sampleOpportunities: Software engineering internship
Data science placement in engineering or energy analytics
Hackathon team

pathways.title: Consulting and finance
pathways.description: Management, engineering and strategy consulting or finance roles: structuring problems, building the business case and presenting it to clients.
sampleOpportunities: Spring week or summer internship at a consultancy
Student consultancy project with a charity or start-up
Graduate analyst programme in banking or energy trading

pathways.title: Start-up founder
pathways.description: Building a venture from an engineering idea: customer discovery, prototyping, pitching and leading a small team.
sampleOpportunities: Imperial Enterprise Lab programmes and pitch competitions
Summer internship at an early-stage hardware start-up
Entrepreneurs society venture team

pathways.title: Research and academia
pathways.description: A PhD or research career: deep analytical and computational work, experiments and writing for publication.
sampleOpportunities: Undergraduate Research Opportunities Programme (UROP) placement
Summer research internship in a department lab
PhD studentship after the MEng
